summary.headline: Revolutions of the Year’s Quarters
summary.text: Discussion of determining a city’s zodiac sign and planetary term through the descent of fortunes and malefics, followed by rules for revolving the quarters of the year according to whether the ascendant and lord of the year are fixed, movable, or common signs.
